bullets.text: Crypto Travel Rule Enforced — The UK has implemented the Crypto Travel Rule, requiring Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) to enhance transparency in digital asset transactions to combat financial crime.
AI Governance Evolving — Singapore's Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is shifting towards evidence-based AI governance, impacting financial institutions' compliance and operational strategies.
Regulatory Reporting Modernization — Capital markets organizations are moving towards configuration-driven reporting to improve efficiency and reduce costs amid increasing regulatory scrutiny.
EU Supervisory Reporting Reform — The European Banking Authority (EBA) is proposing reforms to simplify supervisory reporting, which could significantly reduce compliance costs for banks.
Reimagining Chief Data Office — Modern Chief Data Officers (CDOs) must demonstrate the commercial and operational value of data management to maintain credibility and drive business impact.
